games.title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
games.description: Radial ball-deflection survival game for 2–10 contestants. One local player can defend a gate with movement, Magnet, Pulse and Run while AI bots fill remaining seats; arena size is adjustable and phone/network transport is not yet integrated.

source.provenance: Imported unchanged from edmondsonedits/CALLBACK commit ed09d25b690b36b397516e4d77437e3dd21247c8 (game-modes/royal-ballistix/index.html). Upstream repository license: Apache-2.0.

games.title: Royal Roller Ruckus — Crownway Circuit
games.description: A 2–10 racer momentum-driven cage race around the vertical Crownway Circuit with collisions, checkpoints, recovery after falls, bot-filled seats, and CALLBACK remote-input hooks.

source.provenance: Imported from the user-supplied royal_roller_ruckus_v1.4_vertical_crownway.html. The active standalone build imports Three.js 0.180.0 from jsDelivr at runtime.

games.title: Royal Scratch Match
games.description: Imported v0.5 standalone call-and-response rhythm game for 2–10 contestant slots. One local touch/keyboard player is supported by default, remaining slots can be bot-controlled, and additional human slots can receive inputs through the existing JavaScript API. Room-code phone multiplayer is not yet integrated.

source.provenance: Standalone royal_scratch_match_v0.5_ten_player.html created in the user's ChatGPT CALLBACK project and supplied by the user in this chat for import. Imported without gameplay changes as source/index.html. The runtime has no external asset dependencies; the user explicitly requested this project/repository use.

games.title: Royal Sumo
games.description: A 2–10 fighter shrinking-arena physics sumo game with Bash, Dash, stability, knockouts, dynamic camera work and bot-filled contestant slots. The standalone v0.21 source is imported; online phone-room transport is not yet implemented.

source.provenance: Royal Sumo/Crownfall Arena v0.21.0 was developed in the user's ChatGPT CALLBACK project. The exact generated standalone HTML is retained under source/original/. source/index.html differs only by replacing the pinned Three.js 0.180.0 CDN import with the vendored Three.js r180 MIT-licensed build in source/vendor/.

games.title: Royal Twisted — Spiral Keep
games.description: A 2–10 contestant obstacle-survival run around Spiral Keep: jump low cyan rods, duck high coral rods, survive up to seven hits, and race AI or remote-controlled rivals. v0.5 exposes CALLBACK remote-input hooks; the older v0.4 upload is retained as an archive.

source.provenance: Imported from the user-supplied royal_twisted_spiral_keep_v0.5_original_camera_knockback.html. The uploaded v0.4 ten-player build is retained separately under source/archive/ for history. The active build imports Three.js 0.180.0 from jsDelivr at runtime.

games.title: Space Bash — Orbital Breakout
games.description: A self-contained 2–10 contestant arena brawler on a destructible orbital deck: move, grab and throw crates, kick rivals, jump gaps, and outlast CPU opponents. No external runtime assets or network connection are required.

source.provenance: Imported from the user-supplied space_bash_orbital_breakout_v1.13.1_standalone.html. The build is intentionally self-contained and does not require external scripts, modules, WebGL, CDN assets, or a network connection.
